chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: How Buck and Bubbles tapped and Nazarro's famous sons
summary: Buck and Bubbles danced two numbers together in knickers; Green says Nazarro's sons include actor Ben Gazzara and others who became millionaires.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So you weren't with Buck and Bubbles at that point? That was prior?
How -- how far before you had been introduced to them was this act --
Oh, goodness, that was many, many, many years, you know. Gees, I guess -- I wasn't even a teenager when that was happening.
Well, what kind of stuff did they do aside from that running and when the act was going on? Was that --major part of that act, or did they do other things?

Yeah, Well, they did -- like Mr. Bubbles -- they danced. They danced together. They used to tap dance together. See, I guess that's how we -- impression was laid on by Nazarra -- Chuckles and I done, you know. I mean Dancing to the 'Sweet Sue' and the 'Broadway Melody,' you see,
because Buck and Bubbles used to tap dance together, you know. See?
What kind of tapping did they do at that point?

Very good. Expert tap dancing. And Bubbles, he was called Crazy Legs. I don't know where he got -- you know, like skinny, skinny legs, you see, and he wore the pants up like on the shin like, you know. And he wear these caps and things.

Yeah. And Bubbles had a coat on, and always had some kind of sweater like this, you know, and the knickers, you see. But when they danced together, you know, they did excellent tap dance routines, you see. And, you know, --
What -- to what music was it that they danced?

I don't know. I can't exactly say because it might have been Liza in them times. What's the other thing? 'Blue Skies,' songs like that, you see. And they only did about two dances. Of course, the Nat Nazarra and Sons act, see, was actually, see, there's a great stars. That's in vaudeville, see. They went -- they traveled all around the world, till they became millionaires.

He would not let them discontinue their act until they became millionaires, each one of his sons, like from Cliff Nazarra to Nat Nazarra, Jr., see, and I'm telling you, this one that plays Mannix, that's one of Nazarra's sons. John Ireland, he's another one. Then, you know, Ben Gazarra, that's one of his sons, see. See, he had -- he was married twice, Nat Nazarra. He had two wives.
So and one of them had -- already had a son -- like a son, you see. It's like what they'd call a half brother, you see, or something.
